baseline.parameter_contract: Original FP32 video/audio parameters, construct under FP32 default. No direct Half parameter rewrite, no widen-to-pretend-restored fallback.
baseline.video_compute_context: NPU standard FP16 autocast, HF32 matmul/conv false; approved FA environment retained
baseline.parallel: single node 8 HCCL ranks, RANK=LOCAL_RANK=device, set_parallel_size(8, mode='tile', process_group=WORLD), native decoder spatial_parallel false
baseline.parallel_API_evidence: Actual native_sources/vae.py overrides set_parallel_size:477-511 and is_distributed_enabled:728-729; constructor never calls init_distributed. Explicit WORLD bypasses get_world_group fallback. No generic DistributedVaeExecutor instantiation or Omni/DiT distributed initialization is needed on this pinned path.
baseline.compat: R124 IEEE integer half_nan_scope only, preinstall outside timed call. Do not install alignment_hooks124, DiT save-latent hooks, or legacy audit/capture hooks.

corrected_installer_facts.source_dispatch_reason: allowlist only CUDA SM90/100/103; NPU path returns None
corrected_installer_facts.meaning: Actually call installer once during video VAE construction. Record before/after dtype and native_return; real False is an observed no-op baseline, not a fusion performance result.
corrected_installer_facts.optional_preserve_fp32_mode: Explicit R124 bypass records native_called=false/native_return=null, never mislabels that as observed False.
corrected_installer_facts.unexpected_true_or_rewrite: If actual native call narrows any FP32 Parameter, save failure+dtypes and stop before forward, no restoration cast. An active fast installation preserving FP32 still needs a completed external raw baseline before decode.
corrected_installer_facts.hit_receipts: Record installed marker, every 36 block forward/function identity, actual optimized forward entries, qk/residual non-None returns, SiluAndMul forward/cached-dispatch entries and input dtype/is_cuda. Clean timing has no counters.
corrected_installer_facts.activation_guard: Native _optimized_feed_forward's SiluAndMul branch is CUDA-only. SiluAndMul.forward_npu with NO_FUSED_ACT=1 routes eager; never default-switch to 0/EZ1009. Entry count is not proof of fused kernel execution.
corrected_installer_facts.do_not_inherit: R125 VAE-fusion-no-gain conclusion was not an engaged-fusion benchmark: old audit was all FP32 without actual installer/hit receipt. This driver establishes actual engagement instead.

execution_cases.name: cpu_construct
execution_cases.measure: FP32 VAE-only CPU construction/load with native installer observation; no weight artifacts or downloads.

execution_cases.name: video_load
execution_cases.measure: decoder_component.load_to_device then case-boundary NPU drain, separate wall/current-stream events. Parameter dtype recheck before decode.

execution_cases.name: video_clean
execution_cases.measure: Cold call plus 3 warmed complete decode_latent calls on resident decoder/post_quant; one prewarmed/reused event pair and host perf_counter; includes native tiles, gather/blend, temporal/revert/quantizer and NPU drain. D2H/hash/full CPU compare outside timer. No per-module hooks/counters/clones.

execution_cases.name: video_engagement_profile
execution_cases.measure: Separate nonclean complete call. Preallocated event pool regions: decoder tiles, post_quant, native tile gather helper, blend, denormalize/revert, temporal streaming. Host/event regions inclusive, not additive. No callback .cpu or synchronize; only call boundaries synchronize.

execution_cases.name: video_tile_capture
execution_cases.measure: Separate nonclean full call. Clone every complete 36-layer local decoder Float output before gather/blend/quantization; retain <=1GiB GPU scratch, compute per-tile SHA and shape/dtype/count on CPU after entire call. No per-tile .cpu/sync. Does not claim full globally blended Float video equality; marks this limitation.

execution_cases.name: video_offload_audio_load
execution_cases.measure: Explicit stages outside resident timers. Drop video device weights before audio load to avoid extra co-residency.

execution_cases.name: audio_clean
execution_cases.measure: Native FP32 full stereo waveform, cold plus same repeat count; independent load, root events/wall, D2H and complete CPU comparison.

execution_cases.name: audio_engagement_profile
execution_cases.measure: Separate instrumented audio.remote.decode region with preallocated events, no module synchronize.

execution_cases.name: audio_offload_and_cleanup
execution_cases.measure: Restore immutable master bindings; cleanup on success or failure; receipt saving failure must not skip group destruction or mask the original exception.

comparison.full_outputs: All uint8 [1,3,124,768,1344] video pixels and FP32 [1,2,165600] waveform elements; raw-byte SHA plus chunked full CPU mismatch/max/mean/relative RMS diagnostics. CPU finite checks preserve raw transfer bits.
comparison.baseline_repeat: Report complete same-graph repeat differences, do not automatically approve a tolerance or label lossless. User discussion required if interpreting stochastic/nondeterministic deltas.
comparison.active_candidate: External baseline directory must be completed, sources/config/latent unchanged, preserve-fp32 or observed-native-False/no-fast, full .pt CPU output files verify receipt SHA. Any full output/prequant tile byte delta stops all ranks before next call using all_reduce decision; ask user.
comparison.prequant_limit: Per-local-tile fingerprints include complete tensor; not a proof of every globally blended/reverted Float frame. Producing full 1.53GiB Float video requires separate explicit 2GiB cap and scope; current default is uint8 output plus prequantized tile evidence.
comparison.input_guard: Exact bundle SHA/size plus shape/dtype/finite metadata; source latent bytes checked again after decode, no in-place input rewrite.
comparison.acceptance: accepted_lossless is always false in timing summary; engagement/timing/repeat receipts are not numerical acceptance.

output_and_concurrency.run_directory: root / new lowercase label, rank0 exclusive mkdir 0700; never reuse a label
output_and_concurrency.receipt_publish: unique same-directory temp file open(x), fsync, verified-path os.replace; only own per-rank JSON target
output_and_concurrency.disk_cap: 1GiB run-wide raw reference data default: video saved once rank0, waveform per rank; bounded serialization overhead checked, no weights. No local .pt/.npz activation download.
output_and_concurrency.events: 512 preallocated/prewarmed slots per region, overflow completes native work then marks/raises at case boundary rather than stranding collective peers mid-call.
output_and_concurrency.resource_policy: lead alone executes and manages lease. Subagent neither shells remote nor starts background model jobs. No shared runtime/model/checkpoint edits.
